summary: Pinned curl to its installed version 8.17.0-r1 on node1 by constraining the /etc/apk/world entry from a bare "curl" to "curl=8.17.0-r1", proved the pin survives a real system update (56 other packages upgraded, curl untouched), and completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol (boot_id changed, curl version and pin verified intact post-restart).
actions_performed: Captured baseline: curl 8.17.0-r1 installed, apk world file contents (cmd-973b9d71d7ee4b37, cmd-cc5718e5dc124431)
Edited /etc/apk/world to pin curl=8.17.0-r1 via sed (cmd-6d18e16b90df415f)
Ran apk update, confirmed repo reachable and a newer curl (8.22.0-r0) exists upstream via apk policy (cmd-b235c75d9f0a47b9, cmd-0db5ded982084f09)
Ran apk upgrade --simulate showing 58 packages would upgrade, curl absent from the list (cmd-bd8cf3c2f22b4fa4)
Ran a real apk upgrade (56 packages upgraded including kernel/initramfs); verified curl still 8.17.0-r1 afterward (cmd-e65831e128184289)
Captured pre-restart boot_id, uptime, curl version and pin as healthy baseline (cmd-453af031c65144db)
Issued backgrounded reboot so acknowledgement returned before disconnect (cmd-0af72a94d5444011)
Polled node1 through disconnect until it became reachable again (cmd-99e8b57d7e664865 ... cmd-fa82625dea734af1), confirmed new boot_id and uptime 0m (cmd-71427261b5ec4bd3)
Verified post-restart: curl version unchanged, /etc/apk/world pin intact, apk upgrade --simulate still shows no curl upgrade (cmd-be52f0bbf855478b)

evidence.requirement: curl held at current version (8.17.0-r1) via apk world pin
evidence.summary: Baseline curl version captured (8.17.0-r1) and /etc/apk/world edited to pin curl=8.17.0-r1

evidence.requirement: pin proven effective against an actual system update, not just config presence
evidence.summary: A newer curl (8.22.0-r0) exists upstream; simulated and then real apk upgrade (56 packages) ran and curl remained at 8.17.0-r1 afterward
Captured boot_id 449667a4-..., uptime, curl version/pin as pre-restart baseline
Backgrounded reboot command returned ack immediately, prior to node disconnecting

evidence.requirement: node1 restarted and boot identity changed (not just service/uptime)
evidence.summary: Node became unreachable then reachable again with a new boot_id (29f77c28-...) differing from baseline and uptime reset to 0 minutes

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required package/pin state
evidence.summary: After restart, curl still 8.17.0-r1 and functional, /etc/apk/world pin intact, and apk upgrade --simulate confirms curl still excluded from upgrades
